response.sql: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_average FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), overall AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_average FROM Products), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_average, o.overall_average FROM type_averages t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.type_average > o.overall_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS mean_average FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.type_average) AS average_type_price, AVG(k.type_average - k.overall_average) AS average_above_overall, AVG(k.type_average - m.mean_average) AS average_above_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.type_average > m.mean_average;
